coordinate_conventions.ar: conditional intercept is the unconditional mean; positive phi multiplies y[t-p]-mu
coordinate_conventions.ma: positive theta adds prior recursively computed innovations; all N residuals are scored
coordinate_conventions.arimax: intercept plus trend and Fourier mean; level covariates align by raw timestamp and are not differenced

optimizer.method: closed-form conditional Gaussian regression and profiled innovation scale
fixed-seed bounded differential evolution followed by 26 bounded L-BFGS-B starts
optimizer.local_message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

arimax_interaction.model: ARIMAX(1,0,1) with intercept, linear trend, one Fourier harmonic, and two current level covariates

known_default_de_failure.disposition: preserved open; changing the default optimizer policy or evaluation budget requires technical-authority approval
